before: A checkpoint wrote the `w:pPr` or `w:rPr` that compose draws only to hold a change record where the paragraph or the run has none, and its open read that container as the item's own, so a decision after the fold wrote an empty `<w:pPr/>` or `<w:rPr/>` where the room writes none.
after: A checkpoint marks each such container with `oc:drawn="1"` in its own namespace, and an open drops each marked one that is empty once its records are out, so a decision gives the same Word file live and after a fold.
reason: Change messages, the change log and the Yjs document format do not change. The checkpoint gains one optional attribute in its own namespace; the manifest and its version 5 stay. An older reader drops the attribute as it drops every attribute of the namespace and reads the checkpoint as before; this reader reads a checkpoint without the attribute as before. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
